title: Compose canonical V ingress with exact cluster SRAM residency
hypothesis: A target-owned V transposer can replace the synthetic fill plane with exact canonical addresses, double-buffer metadata, row-level backpressure, and verifiable SRAM readback.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can every canonical V byte fill and be read from the existing exact cluster SRAM without an external synthetic row source?
include: complete 128 KiB int8 V head tile
real 16-bank double-buffer endpoint residency and readback
exclude: multiple transpose buffers and fill/drain overlap

remaining_abstractions: The endpoint arrays remain inferred storage rather than characterized SRAM macros.
One transpose buffer serializes fill and drain and is not the expected throughput frontier.
Capacity-resident and transient-HBM gather scheduling remain external.
Shared-mesh source routing and the external HBM controller/PHY remain external.
